questions.question: Your background includes managing multiple international tax projects and deadlines at Coca-Cola. How would you apply that organization and attention to detail to processing a high volume of invoices and journal entries during month-end close?
Describe the process you used to prepare and maintain supporting documentation for tax returns. How did you ensure the documentation was complete, accurate, and easy for others to review?
This role requires obtaining proper invoice coding and approvals before payment. What experience do you have with tax coding or reviewing financial information for correct classification?
When researching a technical international tax issue, how did you identify the issue, evaluate available guidance, and communicate your conclusion to the relevant stakeholders?
How do you prioritize work when several items have fixed deadlines, such as invoice payments, expense reports, month-end reconciliations, and year-end reporting?
What steps would you take if a vendor contacted you about an invoice they believe is overdue, but the invoice record or required approval could not be located?
This position requires monthly reconciliation of corporate credit card activity and vendor statements. Please walk me through how you would approach a reconciliation and investigate a discrepancy.

You have experience preparing foreign tax forms, partnership returns, corporate returns, and individual returns. Which aspects of that work have most strengthened your ability to learn a new accounting system such as Yooz or Intacct?

The role involves collecting W-9s and preparing 1099-NEC information at year-end. What controls or tracking method would you use to ensure vendor tax documentation is collected and maintained throughout the year?

Describe a time when you had to explain a complex requirement or resolve a question with someone outside your immediate accounting function. How did you make sure the communication was clear and productive?
